### STA 4322 — Introduction to Mathematical Statistics I {.unanchored}

<div class="course-university">University of South Florida</div>

A theory-based introduction to mathematical statistics covering probability
distributions, transformations of random variables, sampling distributions,
and asymptotic results. The course develops statistical inference through
point estimation, confidence intervals, properties of estimators, and
hypothesis testing.



<div class="course-tags">
<span>Mathematical Statistics</span>
<span>Probability</span>
<span>Statistical Inference</span>
</div>
:::

### STA 4222 — Sample Survey Design {.unanchored}

<div class="course-university">University of South Florida</div>

An introduction to the theory and practice of sample survey design, including
simple random, systematic, stratified, cluster, and two-phase sampling.
Additional topics include ratio and regression estimation, nonresponse,
complex surveys, variance estimation, and implementation using statistical
software.


<div class="course-tags">
<span>Survey Sampling</span>
<span>Sampling Design</span>
<span>Estimation</span>
</div>
:::

### STA 4102 — Methods for Applied Statistics {.unanchored}

<div class="course-university">University of South Florida</div>

A computational introduction to applied statistics with an emphasis on R
programming and data analysis. Topics include data manipulation and
visualization, simulation, probability distributions, statistical inference,
ANOVA, linear regression, logistic regression, and interpretation of
statistical output.



<div class="course-tags">
<span>Applied Statistics</span>
<span>Data Analysis</span>
<span>Statistical Modeling</span>
</div>
:::
